description: Frozen local contracts used by competitor_eval_runner.py. Product failures and unsupported capabilities remain terminal ledger rows.

benchmark_scope.denominator_source: currently available local frozen package files
benchmark_scope.availability_policy: READY or READY_ADAPTED when the supplied local manifest, documents, questions, and Gold are internally usable; paper-declared files absent from the local package are metadata/protocol limitations, not a preflight blocker.

defaults.resource_isolation: fresh dataset or knowledge base plus a fresh bound native application for every resource in a new run
defaults.configured_resource_reuse: disabled unless --reuse-configured-resource or COMPETITOR_EVAL_REUSE_CONFIGURED_RESOURCE=1; same-run resume uses resource-map

artifact_layout.documents: The assigned ready-v1 form uses artifacts.corpus.jsonl. Each JSONL row contains doc_id, title, optional inline content, text_path, optional binary_path, media_type, scope_id, sha256, and metadata.ingest_role. Inline content is authoritative for candidate_text/image-description rows; a shared source JSONL is never uploaded once per candidate, and a copied documents/ directory is not required.
artifact_layout.questions: questions.jsonl rows are keyed by question_id and may contain question, reference_answer, scope_doc_ids, gold_doc_ids, and gold_evidence.
artifact_layout.gold: gold.jsonl is optional when question rows carry Gold; when present it is joined by question_id and contributes reference_answer, gold_doc_ids, and gold_evidence.

scope.global: One isolated platform resource contains all supported documents.
scope.document_local: One isolated platform resource is created per scope_id. scope_doc_ids may name a scope_id or candidate doc_id and must resolve to exactly one scope group; all candidate IDs remain available for Gold scoring.

ingest_representation.candidate_markdown: Materialize one deterministic UTF-8 Markdown artifact per scope with competitor-eval-candidate JSON markers carrying doc_id plus available page/layout/quote locators, followed by inline candidate content.
ingest_representation.source_document: Upload each unique original source document path once per scope. A missing source is terminal UNSUPPORTED, not a package-load blocker.
ingest_representation.mixed_role_rule: A condition with both source_document and candidate_text rows must explicitly declare ingest_representation; the runner never silently mixes native source and controlled candidate text.

document_record.path: path relative to package root, or an inline content record

question_record.question: query text (query is accepted as an alias)
question_record.document_id: document identifier for document_local (document_ids is also accepted)
question_record.answer: gold answer (gold_answer and expected_answer are accepted aliases)
question_record.images: optional image paths for multimodal QA

package.unsupported_policy: Do not remove a document or question. Emit a terminal UNSUPPORTED row with reason and preserve it in every planned denominator.

create_bound_native_app.failure_policy: Native QA is BLOCKED or UNSUPPORTED; never fall back to DIFY_LOCAL_APP_ID.

media.image_note: The runner freezes the Qianfan vision model for image conditions, but this Dify chat contract does not accept an image message; image-input QA is terminal UNSUPPORTED unless a future contract is added.
media.ingest_representation_note: candidate_markdown and native source-document file upload are implemented; original PDFs are uploaded once per scope.

readiness.ready_condition: all expected collections have trainingAmount=0, activeTrainingAmount=0, finalErrorAmount=0, and no hasError

create.payload: build_isolated_app_payload bound to the new dataset_id

create_bound_native_app.failure_policy: Native QA is BLOCKED or UNSUPPORTED; never fall back to FASTGPT_APP_ID or the account key for QA.

media.image_note: Image input is sent only through the OpenAI-compatible message content contract and is never inferred from an answer.
media.ingest_representation_note: candidate_markdown and text-like source documents use collection/pushData. Native source-PDF ingestion is terminal UNSUPPORTED because this frozen contract has no binary upload operation.

retrieval.rule: Never label an admin hit_test response public_direct_retrieval. Keep the diagnostic response and mark the public retrieval metric UNSUPPORTED.

native_qa.path_resolution: public root /chat/api plus the resource-map application_id: /{application_id}/chat/completions; any historical application segment in MAXKB_OPENAI_BASE_URL is stripped

create_bound_native_app.failure_policy: Native QA is BLOCKED or UNSUPPORTED; never fall back to MAXKB_APPLICATION_ID or MAXKB_APP_KEY.

media.image_note: Image input is allowed only for the configured OpenAI-compatible native QA endpoint; admin hit_test remains diagnostic text retrieval.
media.ingest_representation_note: candidate_markdown and text-like source documents use paragraph batch_create. Native source-PDF ingestion is terminal UNSUPPORTED; PDF bytes are never decoded as UTF-8 paragraphs.

failure_taxonomy.SUCCESS: A terminal response was received and contained a stage result.
failure_taxonomy.EMPTY: A terminal HTTP/API response was received but no hit or answer was returned.
failure_taxonomy.TIMEOUT: The request or bounded readiness wait timed out; keep it in the planned denominator.
failure_taxonomy.FAILED: A product, transport, provider, or validation error occurred; keep it in the planned denominator.
failure_taxonomy.BLOCKED: A required local credential or ready resource is missing; keep it in the planned denominator.
failure_taxonomy.UNSUPPORTED: The package media or platform contract cannot perform this operation; keep the question in the terminal ledger.
failure_taxonomy.INTERRUPTED: The process stopped before a terminal response; resume from resource-map and terminal-ledger.

artifact_policy.app_secret_directory: secrets/ (contains an internal .gitignore; secret files are mode 0600)
artifact_policy.app_secret_reference: resource-map stores app_id, native_app.bound_resource_id, and app_key_secret_path only; it never stores the key value
artifact_policy.raw_http_policy: Every ArtifactHTTP request/response is recursively redacted and gets a SHA-256 sidecar.
